title: How Iman Gadzhi built a six-figure-a-month marketing agency from age 16 to 20
summary: A compiled four-year timeline of Iman's agency, from a £380/month first client in 2016 to $20k/month at 17 and $100k monthly profit by 2019. Covers niching down, retainers plus performance pay, retention, and the habits and mindset behind it.

principles.text: Find a high-income skill: if you deliver 100 units of value and charge 20, buyers hire you.
principles.quote: I found a high income producing skill right so I found something where if I learn this skill I am worth a lot of money I am worth a lot of money to other people

principles.text: Specialize in one service and a sweet-spot niche as you scale instead of offering everything.
principles.quote: once you hit that 7even fig year mark you're really going to need to specialize in on one service offering

principles.text: Grow through traction, not by adding extra services.
principles.quote: the real power in business is traction not addition um it's not adding extra [ __ ]

principles.text: Add a performance percentage on top of retainers; flat retainers alone left money on the table.
principles.quote: pretty much every single one of our deals these days does have a percentage of row as so basically a performance Kickback within that

principles.text: Maximize retention: a few clients staying 12-18 months can carry large monthly profit.
principles.quote: if you've got Clan staying on for for 12 months 18 months you really don't need many of them to consistently be clocking in 100 200k months profit with the agency

principles.text: Don't qualify yourself in meetings; act like you belong from the start and turn your age into an advantage.
